briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 push frontier capabilities as compute arms race intensifies

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race has accelerated with multiple frontier model releases this month. Safety concerns mount as production systems face persistent exploits while investment flows exceed $11B quarterly.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI launched o4 with enhanced multi-step reasoning; Anthropic released Claude 4 Opus; xAI deployed Grok-3 on expanded Memphis cluster; DeepSeek-V3 gains traction in open-source benchmarks.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New NIST guidelines emphasize runtime monitoring for agentic systems.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC ramps 2nm production for AI accelerators; Microsoft announces $4B Texas data center expansion; NVIDIA Blackwell shipments hit 500k units monthly amid ongoing power constraints.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will regulatory fragmentation between US, EU and China slow the deployment of agentic AI systems by more than 18 months?
